raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer repeatedly clicked on irrelevant links and advertisements, such as the Keyence product page, instead of focusing on extracting relevant information (addresses and class schedules) from martial arts school listings. This caused the process to deviate from the task of identifying suitable martial arts schools within a five-minute walk from the New York Stock Exchange. This failure to gather accurate and relevant data directly contributed to the incorrect final answer.
